extraction.Name: Leon Roubideaux
extraction.Buyer: $1500.00 in cash, from W. H. Tackett
extraction.NOTES: Allottee states patent was delivered in 1915 when he was at Genoa Indian School, and that he must have been about 17 or 18 at the time; records show patent was not issued until December 29, 1917; allottee states he was not at Genoa in 1918 so there must be a mistake; did not ask for the patent; has no children; wife is dependent on him; questionnaire notarized by Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32, on May 7, 1929
